```{=html}
<style>
  .hero canvas.eigenflow { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: -1; }
  .opt-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 1rem; margin: 2.5rem 0 .2rem; }
  .opt-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.15rem; }
  .opt-head button { font: inherit; font-size: .85rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #ddd); background: none; color: inherit; border-radius: 999px; padding: .15rem .8rem; cursor: pointer; }
  .opt-note { color: var(--muted); font-size: .92rem; margin: 0 0 .5rem; }
  @media (max-width: 640px) { .hero canvas.eigenflow { display: none; } }
</style>

<div class="opt-head"><h2>Current</h2><button data-restart="b0">Restart</button></div>
<p class="opt-note">Fast-forwards 62% of the band before the first frame; t = 0 sits in the faded part.</p>
<section class="hero">
  <canvas class="eigenflow" id="b0" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
  <div class="hero-text">
    <p class="eyebrow">Statistical physics <span class="x">×</span> machine learning</p>
    <h1 class="hero-name">Dario Bocchi</h1>
    <p class="hero-role">PhD · Sapienza University of Rome<br><span class="next-dot"></span>Incoming postdoc · ENS Paris</p>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="opt-head"><h2>Option 1 · start from scratch</h2><button data-restart="b1">Restart</button></div>
<p class="opt-note">All eigenvalues are born as one dot at the right edge and fan out live; the band fills in about 25 s.</p>
<section class="hero">
  <canvas class="eigenflow" id="b1" data-prefill="0" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
  <div class="hero-text">
    <p class="eyebrow">Statistical physics <span class="x">×</span> machine learning</p>
    <h1 class="hero-name">Dario Bocchi</h1>
    <p class="hero-role">PhD · Sapienza University of Rome<br><span class="next-dot"></span>Incoming postdoc · ENS Paris</p>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="opt-head"><h2>Option 2 · short fast-forward, visible origin</h2><button data-restart="b2">Restart</button></div>
<p class="opt-note">Fast-forwards 40% of the band, with a softer fade, so the t = 0 point is clearly visible at first and then drifts off to the left.</p>
<section class="hero">
  <canvas class="eigenflow" id="b2" data-prefill="0.4" data-fade-from="0" data-fade-to="0.45" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
  <div class="hero-text">
    <p class="eyebrow">Statistical physics <span class="x">×</span> machine learning</p>
    <h1 class="hero-name">Dario Bocchi</h1>
    <p class="hero-role">PhD · Sapienza University of Rome<br><span class="next-dot"></span>Incoming postdoc · ENS Paris</p>
  </div>
</section>

<script src="assets/eigenflow.js?v=9" defer></script>
<script>
  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var id = e.target.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute("data-restart");
    if (id) { var c = document.getElementById(id); if (c && c.eigenflow) c.eigenflow.restart(); }
  });
</script>
```
